market_outlook.short_term: Markets volatile and risk-off. Bond yields near 20-year highs create headwind for equities. Oil above $103 on Houthi/Iran risk supports energy but pressures inflation. Trump-Xi truce provides limited relief. Expect whipsaw as oil cools and bond selloff fades. Dollar strength caps EM. Meta/AI names provide selective upside. Net: cautious, range-bound with downside skew.
market_outlook.long_term: High-yield bond environment structural; inflation sticky from energy and fiscal policy. AI commerce consolidation creates winners/losers over 12-18 months. Defense spending elevated. China trade truce fragile. Yen weakness persistent. Energy transition policy (diesel, gas storage) reshapes commodity flows. Consumer resilience tested by rates. AI disruption in media/entertainment irreversible.
